svg.text: Blue-Violet-Red — blank ΔE ladder, 0 to 15 (lightness direction)
Every integer step of lightness offset from the exact arc colour, both directions.
Place a real pencil by eye: which row (ΔE/direction) and which t (position left-right) does it look closest to? Report as e.g. "ΔE 11 tint, t=0.7".
